decisions.reason: As an authentication and identity delegation service close to the firm's geospatial enterprise integration capabilities, and with stronger website presence in 2024, it fits existing knowledge that the firm's in-house R&D can further develop commercially.

The open GIS application development framework is close to the firm's established software and platform business and benefits from its broad technical base, though its more limited website prominence suggests somewhat less market traction than the strongest products.

This identity and access service for GIS applications is highly related to the firm's core integration offer and moved from a launch mention to its own page, indicating that the firm can readily absorb feedback and improve it through its R&D capabilities.

The geodata business process consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's consulting and training strengths, so despite being newer, it is well within the firm's knowledge base and likely to be retained as a complementary service.
